source_pattern.code: pub fn withdraw(env: Env, recipient: Address, amount: i128) { recipient.require_auth(); env.storage().instance().set(&DataKey::Balance, &0); }

provenance.note: Omitting require_auth() on privileged actions allows arbitrary callers to execute state mutations.

source_pattern.code: pub fn update_admin(env: Env, current_admin: Address, new_admin: Address) { current_admin.require_auth(); env.storage().instance().set(&DataKey::Admin, &new_admin); }

provenance.note: Authenticating the recipient or new admin instead of current owner allows privilege takeover.
Failing to extend storage TTL causes state entries to be archived and inaccessible upon ledger expiry.

source_pattern.code: pub fn payout(env: Env, vault: Address, beneficiary: Address, amount: i128) { let client = token::Client::new(&env, &token_id); client.transfer(&vault, &beneficiary, &amount); }

provenance.note: Inverting sender and recipient transfers funds from the beneficiary back to the vault.

source_pattern.code: pub fn store_config(env: Env, key: Symbol, value: Val) { env.storage().persistent().set(&key, &value); }

provenance.note: Using temporary storage instead of persistent causes contract state to disappear after transaction boundaries.

source_pattern.code: pub fn query_price(env: Env, oracle: Address) -> i128 { env.invoke_contract(&oracle, &symbol_short!("price"), vec![&env]) }

provenance.note: Substituting target contract address causes calls to target the caller itself or an arbitrary contract.
